name: external-service-pings-failed
title: The frontend service is unavailable based on pingdom
description: The external service pingdom has not hit our /health-check/pingdom endpoint in 5 minutes. Service could be offline.
investigation_steps: Open the frontend and check if the service responds and then check the /health-check/pingdom endpoint.
If the service is unavailable, escalate this as soon as possible, an incident will likely need to be raised if this is the case.
Check if the ECS tasks are running if there's no response then check the logs of services that are failing
